name: Demo Selenium JavaScript for NHS Wales
summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in JavaScript, driving a real Chrome browser against the live production NHS Wales website.
description: This repo demonstrates Selenium WebDriver browser automation testing with JavaScript and Node.js, using the real NHS Wales website (https://www.nhs.wales/) as a friendly real-world example. It drives a real Chrome browser and runs three real, assertion-based checks: the home page title, the About Us page title and headline, and the search results page content.
